name: Luk Fook Holdings (International) Limited
summary: Luk Fook Holdings (International) Limited, an investment holding company, engages in sourcing, designing, wholesaling, trademark licensing, and retailing various gold and platinum jewelry, and gem-set jewelry products in Hong Kong and internationally. The company offers ring and pair rings, necklaces, pendants, earrings, bangles and bracelets, charms, figurines, solid gold figurine, accessories, and other products of various materials comprising fiberglass, diamond, gold, platinum, jadeite, gemstone, pearl, and silver materials.
